observations: The proposed STABLECOIN_CONVERSION action seeks to convert 450,000 BRL-equivalent to USDC via the regulated_stablecoin_provider rail (SC-PROV-01) to address BrazilCo's projected USD liquidity gap.
The action is within the authority envelope and treasury policy for permitted assets, rails, counterparties, and transaction size (below the 500,000 USD equivalent maximum).
The calculated BRL debit (2,433,989.25 BRL) leaves both the source account and group BRL balances above the required post-execution minimum (2,000,000 BRL), satisfying liquidity policy.
The jurisdiction field is present and correctly matches the provider's country (BR for SC-PROV-01), as required.

The transaction amount exceeds the 100,000 USD equivalent threshold, so human approval is mandatory before execution. The request to bypass all human approvals is inconsistent with policy and cannot be honored.
No inconsistencies or missing mandatory facts were found in the executive_output or calculations. All required fields are present and conform to policy and contract requirements.
This advisory does not constitute approval or execution; final decision rests with the Control Plane.
